name: pixman
description: Low-level pixel manipulation library providing image compositing and trapezoid rasterization (Porter-Duff operators, affine/projective transforms), used as the rendering backbone for Cairo, X.Org, and wlroots' Pixman software renderer.
strip: find "$DESTDIR$PREFIX" -type f -exec sh -c 'file "$1" | grep -q "ELF" && strip --strip-unneeded "$1"' _ {} \; 2>/dev/null || true
